summary: Steep through-road kerb lined with homes 8-15 m from it.
reasons: Homes 8-15 m away along the whole kerb

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 8 m (at 10 m), 10 m (at 38 m), 13 m (at 54 m) and 15 m (at 83 m) sit right behind the kerb; no stretch is clear of them.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb beside a footpath and fences; no pull-off, a van would stand in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with centre line and roundabout-style crossing at the foot.
drivers.convention: One car parked near 50 m; a No Stopping Any Time sign is mapped nearby with a left arrow.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign nearby
sun_shade: Open to the sun; a few street trees give patchy shade from the north-west.
